description: Defines a custom exception class EmailParamMappingException used within the campaign email outbound process in Fineract. It extends RuntimeException and wraps another exception.

classes.name: EmailParamMappingException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class used to indicate errors related to email parameter mapping in the campaign process.
